data.name: Global Woods International
data.description: global-woods international AG is a German project developer that develops afforestation/reforestation and biochar carbon removal projects in Latin America (Paraguay, Argentina) and East Africa (Uganda). In May 2025 TÜV Rheinland verified their Forestal Río Aquidabán project in Paraguay, which issued ~200,000 emission removal units on the International Carbon Registry, and the company is expanding into biochar CDR in Uganda with a facility planned to launch in 2026.
